{{Quote|The ship isn't armed yet but there is an ''energy shield'' on the planet's surface protecting it.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], regarding the ''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser being built at the planet's shipyards|<ref name="Hotshot (comic)">{{TCWComicCite|6.54|Hotshot (comic story)}}</ref>}}
A '''planet''' was located in the [[Enoth system/Legends|Enoth system]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] used the [[Unidentified Enoth system shipyards|shipyards]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to build a [[Unidentified Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]], while the [[Heavy cruiser/Legends|heavy cruiser's]] [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was located on the planet's surface.
